item.title: Former FedEx driver Tanner Horner sentenced to death for killing 7-year-old girl
item.summary: A former FedEx driver has been sentenced to death after he pleaded guilty to killing a 7-year-old girl he took from her Texas home while delivering a Christmas gift

item.title: WATCH: Woman arrested after driving on sidewalk toward child riding bike, police say
item.summary: A woman was arrested last week in Spokane, Washington, after she allegedly drove onto a sidewalk and nearly hit a child who was riding a bike, police said.

item.title: WATCH: EMT students tell David Muir about saving instructor who went into cardiac arrest
item.summary: During a CPR lesson at a college in Wisconsin, EMS instructor Karl Arps suddenly went into cardiac arrest. His students noticed the signs and jumped into action, saving his life. David Muir reports.

item.title: WATCH: Washington driver arrested after chasing child riding bike on sidewalk
item.summary: Alarming video shows the moment a woman drove onto a sidewalk chasing a child who was a riding a dirt bike. The driver has been arrested and charged with felony assault, DUI and trespassing.
